text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I guess that was okay...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But I really wanted to get first place for
all the
younger students who came to
watch me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I guess I've still got a ways to go...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heh, thanks for trying to make me feel
better.
choice_data_list: 悪いレースじゃなかった
気合いを入れていこう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's go into this fired up!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, but I shouldn't be making you
worry.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All right! Next time, I'm going to turn it up to eleven, keep up the pace, and win!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Losing all the time is definitely not my
bag!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll give everyone a real taste of my
speed next
time!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now we just need to take a refreshing
drive!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Let's ride Tata all the way to the beach!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I accompany Maruzensky on a drive
along the
coast until she feels better.
